headline: Palo Alto Networks Stock Rises as Earnings Beat and AI Boosts Outlook
summary: Palo Alto Networks reported earnings showing artificial intelligence has increased cybersecurity stakes, prompting the company to boost its outlook.
why: Palo Alto Networks is a major cybersecurity vendor whose results serve as a bellwether for enterprise security spending and AI integration in software.

impacts.name: Palo Alto Networks
impacts.why: Strong earnings and raised guidance directly lift the company's shares.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The company's positive quarterly results and an upgraded outlook driven by strong AI-related demand boosted investor confidence.
